name: Mending Plate
description: Raise a plate of warm qi that shields the user and eases the sting of a blow that lands.

name: Warm Cover
description: Cover an ally in a layer of warm qi that soaks a heavy blow and begins to ease the bruise.

name: Tender Pace
description: Step to a fallen ally's side with the ward raised and kneel inside its shelter.

name: Hurt Feel
description: Feel through the ward where an ally is hurt and how deeply before the hands go to the wound.

name: Healing Screen
description: Hold a screen over a wounded ally that mends the hurt a little with every blow it turns.

name: Purifying Plate
description: Lay a clean plate against an ally's skin and draw poison and taint out into it.

name: Tended Rebuke
description: Turn a blow back on the striker and let the same stroke ease the user's own ache.

name: Closing Weave
description: Weave threads of qi through an ally's deep wound and draw the edges together under the ward.

name: Restorative Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that restores a measure of an ally's strength with each breath it stands.

name: Reviving Ward
description: Close the ward over an ally whose breath and pulse have just stopped and drive both to begin again.

name: Unwounded Veil
description: Cancel one mighty blow outright and mend what slipped past it before the ally knows of the hurt.

name: Mending Aegis
description: streams: Protection + Healing; fuse the shelter and the mending into one aegis that heals each ally as it turns each blow.

name: Antidote Plate
description: Raise a plate seasoned with bitter qi that turns a poisoned edge before it can scratch.

name: Bitter Cover
description: Cover the skin in a bitter film of qi that no venom or spore can pass.

name: Fume Step
description: Step out of a drifting fume behind a held ward and draw an ally with the user.

name: Taint Whiff
description: Taste the air at the ward's edge for poison and name its kind and its nearness.

name: Poison Turning
description: Turn a poisoned dart or cloud aside along the slick face of the ward.

name: Counter Tonic
description: Steep an ally's blood in a counter-tonic of qi and break down the venom in it.

name: Venom Rebuke
description: Catch a venomed blow on the ward and fling its sting back at the one who loosed it.

name: Spore Seal
description: Seal a cloud of spores inside a closed ward before it can spread to the allies.

name: Venom Aegis
description: Hold an aegis whose surface sours any poison that touches it and renders it harmless.

name: Antivenom Wash
description: Wash the whole of an ally's body with antivenom qi and draw out a deep and long-set poison.

name: Toxic Rebuke
description: Return an attack through the aegis laced with the poison it carried and weakened by the ward.

name: Poisonbane Aegis
description: Cancel a deadly poison or venomed strike outright in one clear sweep of the aegis.

name: Bitter Aegis
description: streams: Protection + Poison; harden the ward with the poison stream so that any foe who strikes it sickens.

name: Antidote Verdict
description: streams: Protection + Poison; turn the poison on a field into a ward that guards every ally within it.

name: Graystone Plate
description: Raise a plate of qi gone dense and gray as stone against the first blow.

name: Earth Brace
description: Sink the ward into the ground and let the ground swallow the force of a heavy blow.

name: Footing Hum
description: Read the soil through the soles for the tremor of a distant charge.

name: Granite Rebuke
description: Return a blow through a plate hard as granite so that the striker's own weight comes back on the striker.

name: Packed Absorb
description: Pack the ward with the weight of earth until a blow dies into it without a sound.

name: Rooted Binding
description: Bind an opponent's feet to the ground with roots of dense qi and hold them fast.

name: Clay Mending
description: Pack a wound with clay-heavy qi that draws its edges together and holds them while the flesh knits.

name: Bedrock Aegis
description: Hold an aegis set into the earth itself that cannot be moved by any force on the surface.

name: Quaking Return
description: Send the stored weight of the earth back through the ground as a quake that topples all near.

name: Deepstone Hush
description: Sink a mighty blow into deep stone and let the stillness of the earth cancel it.

name: Earthen Aegis
description: streams: Protection + Earth; raise a shelter fused with the earth that rises with the ground and bears any single blow.

name: Forged Plate
description: Beat the ward into a plate that rings like struck iron when a blow lands.

name: Tempered Skin
description: Temper the ward on the skin so it flexes under a blow and returns to its shape.

name: Anvil Pace
description: Step with a heavy ringing footfall that plants the ward firmly at each stride.

name: Sheen Gauging
description: Read from the sheen on the ward's face how near it is to cracking.

name: Annealed Turn
description: Turn a blade along a ward annealed smooth so the edge skids and does not bite.

name: Alloy Rebuke
description: Return a blow through an alloyed plate that rings back at the striker with double force.

name: Clamping Vise
description: Close two metal-hard plates on an attacker's weapon and hold it in a vise.

name: Resting Temper
description: Pass the temper of the ward to an ally and harden the ally's guard against the next strike.

name: Bronze Aegis
description: Hold an aegis of burnished metal qi that sheds blows with a ringing note.

name: Ringing Burst
description: Strike the aegis so that a ringing wave of metal qi throws back every attacker near.

name: Seamless Shroud
description: Draw the ward seamless and unbroken over the user and let the shock pass through unharmed.

name: Hammered Absolute
description: Hammer the ward into one flawless face on which a mighty blow breaks and is cancelled.

name: Wrought Aegis
description: streams: Protection + Metal; temper the aegis through the metal stream into a barrier that holds like forged steel.
